headlines.title: Bay Area weather live updates: Waves crash over Pacifica seawall, floods neighborhood
headlines.description: Monster waves and king tides flooded several roads along the coast in Pacifica's Sharp Park neighborhood Wednesday, prompting some to evacuate. Palmetto Avenue between Clarendon Road and Montecito Avenue closed to traffic as flood waters moved inland. Clarendon Road from Beach Boulevard to Lakeview Avenue also shut down as it was inundated with water and sea foam. Some residents evacuated themselves and their pets, wading through high water levels. Others watched from above, sitting on rooftops. bay area storm 7 hours ago Santa Cruz County 16 minutes ago Pacifica 30 minutes ago First responders were in the area helping residents after an evacuation advisory was issued in the morning for a section between the ocean and state Highway 1, north of the Sharp Park Golf Course. Curious onlookers crowded up to the road closure boundaries to try and witness the massive waves and flooded roads. An end section of the Pacifica Municipal Pier collapsed into the ocean as well in the morning. Beach Boulevard, the road closest to the shore, was also mostly off limits.
headlines.source: Joel Soria, Brendan Weber and Kristofer Noceda
